questions.expl: ：孩子们试图救出小猫，但他们做不到。 and 和；but 但是；though 尽管；so 所以。根据“The kids tried to free the cat...they couldn’t”可知，前 后句意转折，用but，故选B。
：小猫看起来太可爱了，以至于孩子们问母亲能否收养它。 too 太；as 因为；that 那个；what 什么。根据“The cat looked so cute...the kids asked…”可知，此处是 so...that...“如此……以至于……”引导的结果状语从句。故选C。
：母亲说：“我自己不介意，但你们也得问问父亲。” me 我；my 我的(形容词性物主代词)；mine 我的(名词性物主代词)；myself 我自己。根据“I don’t mind...”可知，此处需反身代词表示“我自己不介意”，故选D。
：孩子们兴奋地等待父亲下班回家。 exciting 令人兴奋的(修饰物)；excited 感到兴奋的(修饰人)；excitedly 兴奋地(副词)；excitement 兴奋(名词)。根据“The kids waited...”可知，此处需副词修饰动词“waited”，故选C。

：当他们听到父亲开门时，同时大喊“爸爸好！” opens 打开(动词三单)；opened 动词过去式；opening 现在分词/动名词；to open 动词不定式。根 据“heard their father...the door”可知，此处是短语hear sb doing sth，表示“听到某人正在做某事”，故 选C。 6．句意：当他们听到父亲开门时，同时大喊“爸爸好！” at 在；in 在……里；for 为了；by 通过。固定搭配“at the same time”表示“同时”，故选A。
：“你们今天见到我一定比平常更开心啊。怎么了？”父亲说。 happy 开心的；happier 更开心的；happily 开心地；happiest 最开心的。根据“than usual”可知，此处 需用比较级，故选B。
：“没什么，爸爸。我们只是太爱你了。”女孩回答。
：我们到现在已经养了五只猫。 five-cat 错误表达；five cats 五只猫；five-cats 错误表达；five cat 错误表达。根据“We have fed...up till now”可知，是指五只猫，five cats 符合题意，故选B。
：我和你妈妈没时间再照顾它了。 take 拿(动词原形)；to take 动词不定式；taking 动名词/现在分词；took 动词过去式。固定搭配“have no time to do”表示“没时间做某事”，故选B。
：看到孩子们脸上的悲伤表情，父亲改变了主意。 a 一个(泛指，用于辅音音素前)；an 一个(泛指，用于元音音素前)；the 这个，特指；/不填。 根据“sad looks”可知，此处是特指孩子们的表情，故选C。
：既然你们这么爱它，可以养它。 can 可以；must 必须；should 应该；had better 最好。根据“Since you love it so much”可知，父亲给 予许可，应用can，故选A。
：但是要答应我你们自己照看它。 promise 答应(动词原形)；promised 动词过去式/过去分词；promising 动名词/现在分词；to promise 动词不定式。“But...me to look after it yourselves”可知，此句为祈使句，需用动词原形，故选A。
：孩子们很高兴有另一个宠物朋友。 other 其他的；another 另一个；others 其他人；the others 其余的人/物。根据上下文可知，小猫是新 成员，此处表示泛指，用another，故选B。

：然后小猫被孩子们取名为“Lucky”。 is given 被给(一般现在的被动语态)；gives 给(动词三单)；was given 被给(一般过去时的被动 语态)；gave 给(动词过去式)。根据“by the kids”可知，需用被动语态，且动作发生在过去，故 选C。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，共10 分) 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从16~25 各题所给的Ａ，B，C 和D 项中选出最佳选项。 Gao makes wheelchairs for pets. Over the past 17 years, he has helped many 16 pets be able to walk again. Gao didn’t start out as a professional wheelchair maker. It all began with a small act of 17 Back in 2006, Gao was selling cakes when a street dog limped (瘸着脚走) over to him to ask for food. Feeling sorry for the dog, Gao planned to make a pet wheelchair to help the dog move around more
：这一切都始于一个小小的善良举动。 exploration 探索；journey 旅程；shyness 害羞；kindness 善良。结合后文高晓东因同情瘸腿流浪狗 而制作轮椅的行为，这是充满善心的举动。故选D。
：高晓东同情这只狗，计划制作一个宠物轮椅来帮助它更轻松地活动。 quietly 安静地；carefully 仔细地；easily 容易地；slowly 缓慢地。制作轮椅的目的是改善狗的行走 状况，让它活动更轻松。故选C。
：当他看到这只小狗坐着轮椅能开始快速奔跑时，他产生了一种快乐的感觉。 trouble 麻烦；sadness 悲伤；happiness 快乐；fear 恐惧。看到自己的帮助让小狗恢复行动能力，内 心应是喜悦的。故选C。
：在网上分享了这个故事后不久，高晓东收到一个请求，为一只同样有腿部问题的猫制作 轮椅。 received 收到；prepared 准备；discussed 讨论；promised 承诺。结合语境，此处指收到他人的制作 请求。故选A。
：结果，这只猫的主人对高晓东制作的轮椅非常满意。 patient 耐心的；pleased 满意的；angry 生气的；strict 严格的。根据后文高晓东从此决定做专业宠物 轮椅制作者，可推断主人对成果是满意的。故选B。
：从那以后，高晓东决定成为一名工匠，制作宠物轮椅。 challenged 挑战；remembered 记得；refused 拒绝；decided 决定。前文提到他本不是专业制作者， 因这次成功经历才确定职业方向。故选D。
：“我尝试过很多工作，但制作宠物轮椅对我来说是最好且最有意义的。” meaningful 有意义的；terrible 可怕的；unknown 未知的；dangerous 危险的。结合后文他对人与宠 物关系的感悟，这份工作能带来精神价值，是有意义的。故选A。
：此外，这份工作改变了我，让我理解人与宠物之间的联系。 check 检查；compare 比较；understand 理解；explain 解释。工作经历让他对人与宠物的关系有了 更深的认知。故选C。
：他们一起帮助那些因意外或突发疾病而无法独立行走的动物。 storm 暴风雨；illness 疾病；growth 成长；chance 机会。与“accident(意外)”并列，应是导致行走 困难的负面因素，突发疾病符合语境。故选B。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the author writing Paragraph 1?
opts: To tell us the cat loves to nap in the sun.
To explain why the cat loves to nap in the sun.
To tell us it’s hard for the cat to go up and down stairs.
To explain the stairs are too old for the cat to go up and down.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“getting to his favourite place by the pool means hobbling (跛行) down a flight of stairs every day.”可知，Frodo 要去他最喜欢的泳池边，就得一瘸一拐地走下一段楼梯。由此可知， Frodo 上下楼梯很困难。故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the meaning of the underlined word “struggling” in Chinese?
What can we infer from Paragraph 6?
opts: Thompson would not be worried about Frodo anymore.
The elevator Thompson built for Frodo worked really well.
Frodo didn’t like the elevator built by Thompson.
Frodo was very nervous when he took the elevator built by Thompson.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Frodo seemed very relaxed in the elevator as it made its way to the bottom of the stairs.”可知，在电梯通往楼梯底部的过程中，Frodo 看起来非常放松。由此可推知，电梯运行良好 且Frodo 适应良好。故选B。

questions.stem: Why did Liam Thompson use a toy to test the elevator first?
opts: To make the elevator more attractive to Frodo.
To ensure the elevator was safe for Frodo.
To practice using the elevator himself.
To record a fun video for YouTube.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To make sure the elevator was safe for his old friend, Thompson used a toy to test out his creation.”可知，为了确保电梯对他的老朋友安全，Thompson 用玩具测试了他的发明。故选 B。 30．主旨大意题。全文围绕Thompson 为猫Frodo 建造电梯展开，重点描述了他的动机、制作过程 和结果。故选A。

questions.stem: What’s the main idea of the passage?
opts: Thompson builds an elevator for his cat.
Thompson owns a cat that has thousands of fans.
A cat with a special elevator lives a happy life.
A pet lover has won the hearts of many people.

questions.stem: What problem do the “pet toilets” mainly aim to deal with?
opts: To improve public restroom for humans.
To manage pet waste left in public areas.
To reduce the expenses of raising pets in the city.D．To solve the problem of walking large dogs in the
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段“It has built special ‘pet toilets’ in many communities and shopping malls, which is designed to solve the problem of pet waste.”可知，宠物厕所的核心目的是处理宠物在公共区 域留下的粪便。故选B。

questions.stem: What facility is mentioned as being provided at the Upperhills shopping mall?
opts: Tools for picking up pet waste.
A dedicated restroom next to regular ones.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第三段“Upperhills shopping mall in Futian District also provides trash bins with doggy waste bags and hand-wiping paper”可知，该商场提供装有宠物粪便袋的垃圾桶和擦手纸，属于 “清理宠物粪便的工具”。故选B。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention the Scottish terrier owner’s opinion?
opts: To compare small and large dogs’ needs.
To emphasize that pet toilets benefit all citizens.
To suggest improvements for Shenzhen’s pet facilities
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第四段“The pet toilets meet the physiological needs of pets while also creating a cleaner, more comfortable public space for those who do not own pets.”可知，该主人的观点强调宠物厕 所既满足宠物生理需求，又为非宠物主人创造清洁环境，即“惠及所有市民”。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage about Shenzhen’s attitude towards pets??
opts: It mainly cares about the health of large dogs.
It has become the first city globally to ban eating pets.
It aims to build more new shopping malls with pets.
It is actively working to create a pet-friendly city.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据最后一段“Shenzhen has long been a pioneer... over 50 malls have pet-friendly facilities, with more on the way.”可知，深圳不仅建造宠物厕所，还禁止食用猫狗、推广宠物友好设 施，体现出积极打造宠物友好型城市的态度。故选D。
结构题。综合全文可知，第一段总起：提出宠物厕所新举措；第二、三段分述：列举商场 /社区具体案例；第四段案例/观点支撑：借苏格兰梗犬主人的话，说明宠物厕所对养宠和不养宠人 群的意义；第五段总结升华：深圳的宠物友好政策和发展趋势；因此，本文的结构为“总述(第一 段)→分述(第二、三段)→案例与反馈(第四段)→总结(第五段)”，属于“总——分——总”结构， 选项A 结构图符合题意。故选A。

questions.stem: Why did the writer do the research?
opts: To show the importance of pets.
To know how many pets people have.
To find out which district has the most pets.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To find out more about what pets people prefer (更喜欢), we did a research...” 可知，做研究是为了解人们养宠物的喜好，故选C。

questions.stem: In which district do the most people like cats?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据表格中Cats 一行数据可知，Panlong District 是30%、Wuhua District 是40%、 Xishan District 是35%，故Wuhua District 喜欢猫的占比最高，故选B。

questions.stem: How many people like fishes in the research in Xishan District?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“1,000 people took part in the research in each district.”和表格中Xishan District 一列对应Fishes 的数据可知，Xishan District 参与研究人数是1000，喜欢鱼类(Fishes)的人占比15%， 1000×15% = 150，故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the text?
opts: Dogs are the most popular pets in all three districts.
More people like rabbits than cats in Panlong District.
Fishes are less popular than other pets in Wuhua District.
Xishan District has the fewest dog lovers of the three districts.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据表格中Dogs 一行数据可知，Panlong District 占比45%、Wuhua District 占比 35%、Xishan District 占比25%，故Xishan District 狗爱好者占比最低，故选D。

questions.stem: Where can you probably read the text?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据文章主要内容可知，本文围绕一项关于宠物喜好的研究展开，故最可能在宠 物护理杂志(A pet care magazine)读到，故选D。
